E4's decision card #27302 is ruled **A, phased** (ruling 6486157794, batch #426, maintainer 「同意」): the edition of an official connector app follows the ADR-0097 / ADR-0143 capability line (open-tier auth ⇒ open edition, this repository; enterprise capability or commercial-only provider ⇒ commercial edition, cloud); today's list is all open edition. Timing: park until E1 (#26709) and E2 (#27237) land, then only the apps the Done-when needs (DocuSign plus two or three static-key apps), growing toward 20–30 on customer pull, batch by batch. #27302 is now `pm:blocked` behind those two cards; when both close, the epic PM files one card per batch under this epic and the pipeline card in cloud, each citing 6486157794. The E4 row is yours to update to this ruling.
